title: AVERAGEX leaves out the rows where the expression is BLANK
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", AVERAGEX ( V, IF ( V[N] > 0, V[N] ) ) )

source.quote: AVERAGEX ignores the blank values that Expression returns.
source.supports: rows with a BLANK expression are not in the divisor

derivation: V[N] holds 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 5, BLANK, 2. IF without an else gives BLANK unless N > 0, so the values are 5, 5, 2 and four BLANKs: (5 + 5 + 2) / 3 = 4. Dividing by all 7 rows would give 1.714.
